reg_deadline.en: Registration closed October 13, 2026. Not sure you're registered or active? Check My Vote, because ballots aren't mailed to inactive voters.
reg_deadline.es: El registro cerró el 13 de octubre de 2026. ¿No sabes si estás registrado o activo? Revisa My Vote, porque no se envían boletas a los votantes inactivos.
reg_deadline.quote: Ballots are not mailed to voters with an inactive status.

mail_request.notes: Every active registered voter is mailed a ballot; there is no request deadline.

mail_return.en: Drop box: by 8 p.m. on Tuesday, November 3. Mail: send it by Tuesday, October 27, a week before Election Day. It has to be postmarked by November 3 and reach your county by Tuesday, November 10.
mail_return.es: Buzón de entrega: a más tardar a las 8 p. m. del martes 3 de noviembre. Por correo: envíala a más tardar el martes 27 de octubre, una semana antes del Día de las Elecciones. Tiene que tener matasellos del 3 de noviembre o antes y llegar a tu condado a más tardar el martes 10 de noviembre.
mail_return.quote: Today marks one week until Election Day for the November general election, and the Oregon Secretary of State’s office is recommending that, starting tomorrow, voters exclusively return their ballots via secure, official drop box. ... If mail is the only option, voters should go into their local post office and request a manual postmark be applied to their ballot envelope as soon as possible. To be counted, all ballots must either be put into a drop box by 8 p.m. on Election Day or postmarked by Election Day and received within the 7-day post-election grace period.
mail_return.en_after: Use a drop box by 8 p.m. on Tuesday, November 3. Since October 28, the Secretary of State recommends drop boxes only. If mail is your only option, ask at the post office counter for a hand postmark. A mailed ballot has to be postmarked by November 3 and reach your county by Tuesday, November 10.
mail_return.es_after: Usa un buzón de entrega a más tardar a las 8 p. m. del martes 3 de noviembre. Desde el 28 de octubre, la Secretaría de Estado recomienda usar solo los buzones de entrega. Si el correo es tu única opción, pide en el mostrador de la oficina postal que le pongan el matasellos a mano. Una boleta por correo tiene que tener matasellos del 3 de noviembre o antes y llegar a tu condado a más tardar el martes 10 de noviembre.
mail_return.notes: Oct 27, 2026 SOS release, read Oct 28. Nov 10 from the 2026 Elections Calendar, https://sos.oregon.gov/elections/Documents/current-elections-calendar.pdf: 'November 10, 2026 Last day to receive valid postmarked ballots by mail.' Mail-by Oct 27 recommendation: current-election page (Oct 21).

cure.en: Signature problem? Fix it with your county elections office by Tuesday, November 24, 2026.
cure.es: ¿Hay un problema con tu firma? Corrígelo con la oficina electoral de tu condado a más tardar el martes 24 de noviembre de 2026.
cure.quote: November 24, 2026 Last day to resolve ballot challenges.
cure.notes: 2026 Elections Calendar (SOS), read Oct 28; ORS 254.426, 254.431. Matches 'You will have until 21 days after the election' on the current-election page.

in_person.en: There's no polling place to find. Your ballot comes to you. Need help in person or a replacement ballot? County elections offices are open 7 a.m. to 8 p.m. on Election Day.
in_person.es: No tienes que buscar un lugar de votación: tu boleta te llega a ti. ¿Necesitas ayuda en persona o una boleta de reemplazo? Las oficinas electorales de condado abren de 7 a. m. a 8 p. m. el Día de las Elecciones.
in_person.quote: County elections offices are open 7 am - 8 pm on Election Day.

locator_label.en: Oregon Drop Box Locator (Oregon Secretary of State)
locator_label.es: Oregon Drop Box Locator (Secretaría de Estado de Oregon)

rule.en: Enter your address in the state's drop box locator to find the nearest official drop sites and their hours. You can use any official drop site in Oregon.
rule.es: Escribe tu dirección en el buscador de buzones del estado para encontrar los lugares oficiales de entrega más cercanos y sus horarios. Puedes usar cualquier lugar oficial de entrega en Oregon.
rule.quote: Ballots can be delivered to any Oregon Official Ballot Drop Site during the 20 day voting period until 8:00 PM on Election Day.

accepted.notes: No ID is shown to vote by mail; the signature on the return envelope is the check. The existing FAQ answer covers it.

who.en: Ballots started going out October 14. Didn't get one, or yours got lost or damaged? Call your county elections office for a replacement. Thursday, October 29, is the last day counties have to mail replacement ballots, so after that, ask your county how to pick one up.
who.es: Las boletas empezaron a enviarse el 14 de octubre. ¿No te llegó la tuya, o se perdió o se dañó? Llama a la oficina electoral de tu condado para pedir una boleta de reemplazo. El jueves 29 de octubre es el último día en que los condados tienen que enviar boletas de reemplazo por correo, así que después de esa fecha, pregunta en tu condado cómo recoger una.
who.quote: October 29, 2026 Last day counties required to mail absentee, reissued or replacement ballots.
who.en_after: Ballots started going out October 14. Didn't get one, or yours got lost or damaged? Contact your county elections office for a replacement. Counties no longer have to mail one, so ask how to pick it up. Elections offices are open 7 a.m. to 8 p.m. on Election Day.
who.es_after: Las boletas empezaron a enviarse el 14 de octubre. ¿No te llegó la tuya, o se perdió o se dañó? Comunícate con la oficina electoral de tu condado para pedir una boleta de reemplazo. Los condados ya no tienen que enviarla por correo, así que pregunta cómo recogerla. Las oficinas electorales abren de 7 a. m. a 8 p. m. el Día de las Elecciones.
who.notes: Calendar also: 'November 3, 2026 Election Day. County Clerk's office open 7 am - 8 pm.' Replacement by calling the county: current-election page ('call your county elections office to request a replacement ballot') and the Oct 27 SOS release ('reach out to your county elections office for a replacement ballot').

witness.en: Sign the return envelope yourself. No one else can sign it, and your county compares it with the signatures in your registration record.
witness.es: Firma tú mismo el sobre de devolución. Nadie más puede firmarlo, y tu condado compara la firma con las de tu registro de votante.
witness.quote: You are the only person who can sign your ballot return identification envelope.

cure.en: Forgot to sign, or your signature doesn't match? Your county will send you a challenge notice with instructions. Fix it with your county elections office by Tuesday, November 24.
cure.es: ¿Se te olvidó firmar o tu firma no coincide? Tu condado te mandará un aviso de impugnación (challenge notice) con instrucciones. Corrígelo con la oficina electoral de tu condado a más tardar el martes 24 de noviembre.
cure.quote: If your signature does not match, or you forgot to sign your envelope, the county will send you a challenge notice with instructions. You will have until 21 days after the election to resolve the challenge with your County Elections Office
cure.notes: Nov 24: SOS 2026 Elections Calendar, 'November 24, 2026 Last day to resolve ballot challenges.'

dropbox.en: Official drop boxes stay open until 8 p.m. on Election Day, and you can use any one in Oregon. In line at 8 p.m.? You can still drop off your ballot.
dropbox.es: Los buzones oficiales están abiertos hasta las 8 p. m. del Día de las Elecciones, y puedes usar cualquiera en Oregon. ¿Estás en la fila a las 8 p. m.? Todavía puedes dejar tu boleta.
dropbox.quote: Voters who are in line at 8:00 PM may drop off their ballot.

gear.en: Keep the campaigning away from where ballots are turned in. No electioneering, handing out cards or handbills, or gathering petition signatures inside a building with an elections office that takes ballots, or within 100 feet of its entrances, from the day ballots go out until 8 p.m. on Election Day.
gear.es: Mantén la campaña lejos de donde se entregan las boletas. No se permite hacer campaña, repartir tarjetas o volantes ni juntar firmas para peticiones dentro de un edificio con una oficina electoral que recibe boletas, ni a menos de 100 pies de sus entradas, desde el día en que se envían las boletas hasta las 8 p. m. del Día de las Elecciones.
gear.quote: A person may not do any electioneering, including circulating any cards or handbills, or soliciting of signatures to any petition, within any building in which any state or local government elections office designated for the deposit of ballots under ORS 254.470 is located, or within 100 feet measured radially from any entrance to the building.

line.en: In line at a drop site at 8 p.m.? Stay in line. You can still drop off your ballot.
line.es: ¿Estás en la fila de un lugar de entrega a las 8 p. m.? Quédate en la fila. Todavía puedes dejar tu boleta.
line.quote: Voters who are in line at 8:00 PM may drop off their ballot.

tradition.en: Oregon votes by mail, so the Secretary of State offers two virtual stickers to download and share: "I Voted," with a checked ballot box on an Oregon-shaped flag, and "I Voted By Mail," with a signed ballot envelope.
tradition.es: Oregon vota por correo, así que la Secretaría de Estado ofrece dos stickers virtuales para descargar y compartir: "I Voted", con una casilla marcada sobre una bandera con la forma de Oregon, e "I Voted By Mail", con un sobre de boleta firmado.
tradition.quote: 2026 Elections Toolkit I Voted (virtual sticker) I Voted I Voted By Mail
tradition.notes: Media Resources page, read Oct 28. The two links go to /PublishingImages/media/Voted-Sticker-V2-1.jpg and -2.jpg; images viewed Oct 28. Removed "I Voted (The Oregon Way)": no current SOS asset or page uses that wording. No designer is named.

mail.en: In Multnomah County, sign up for ballot tracking at BallotTrax and you get a virtual "I Voted" sticker to share once your ballot is in. In another county? Ask your county elections office.
mail.es: En el condado de Multnomah, si te inscribes para rastrear tu boleta en BallotTrax, recibes un sticker virtual de "I Voted" para compartir cuando tu boleta llegue. ¿Vives en otro condado? Pregunta en la oficina electoral de tu condado.
mail.quote: You'll even receive a virtual "I Voted" sticker that's ready to share on social media.

provisional.en: If your eligibility to vote can't be confirmed, for example if you're told you aren't registered, you have the right to a provisional ballot. Go to your county elections office in person and fill out a Provisional Ballot Request Form. It counts only if you're found eligible, and you have the right to know whether it was accepted.
provisional.es: Si no se puede confirmar que tienes derecho a votar, por ejemplo, si te dicen que no estás registrado, tienes derecho a una boleta provisional. Ve en persona a la oficina electoral de tu condado y llena un formulario de solicitud de boleta provisional (Provisional Ballot Request Form). Solo cuenta si se confirma que puedes votar, y tienes derecho a saber si fue aceptada.
provisional.quote: Do I need a provisional ballot? If your eligibility to vote can’t be determined, you have the right to request a provisional ballot. To obtain a provisional ballot, go to your county elections office in person and fill out a Provisional Ballot Request Form. Your provisional ballot will only be counted if you are determined to be eligible to vote. ... You have the right to get a “provisional ballot,” even if you are told you are not registered to vote.
provisional.notes: Pass 2 Oct 30: Nov 3, 2026 State Voters' Pamphlet, FAQ page 11 and voter rights page, read in the PDF (pdftotext). Oregon's registration deadline was Oct 13; no Election Day registration (reg FAQ).

line.en: You can still turn in your ballot. Voters in line at a drop site at 8 p.m. may drop it off.
line.es: Todavía puedes entregar tu boleta. Los votantes que estén en la fila de un lugar de entrega a las 8 p. m. pueden dejarla.
line.quote: Voters who are in line at 8:00 PM may drop off their ballot.

track.en: Sign up for BallotTrax at oregonvotes.gov/track to get updates by email, text or phone when your ballot is sent, received and accepted. It's free.
track.es: Inscríbete en BallotTrax en oregonvotes.gov/track para recibir avisos por email, mensaje de texto o llamada cuando tu boleta se envíe, se reciba y se acepte. Es gratis.
track.quote: BallotTrax is a free service that notifies Oregon voters about the status of their mail ballot by phone, email, or text from the time their county elections official mails the outgoing ballot to when their mailed ballot is received and accepted.

unsigned.en: Your county will send you a challenge notice with instructions. You have until Tuesday, November 24, to fix it, and BallotTrax will also tell you if there's a signature problem you can fix.
unsigned.es: Tu condado te mandará un aviso de impugnación (challenge notice) con instrucciones. Tienes hasta el martes 24 de noviembre para corregirlo, y BallotTrax también te avisará si hay un problema con tu firma que puedas corregir.
unsigned.quote: You will have until 21 days after the election to resolve the challenge with your County Elections Office.
unsigned.notes: Nov 24: SOS 2026 Elections Calendar, 'November 24, 2026 Last day to resolve ballot challenges.' (21 days after the election).

late_mail.en: A mailed ballot counts if it's postmarked by November 3 and reaches your county by November 10. Since October 28, the Secretary of State recommends a drop box instead. Drop boxes take ballots until 8 p.m. on November 3. If you have to mail it, ask a post office staff member to hand-stamp the postmark.
late_mail.es: Una boleta por correo cuenta si tiene matasellos del 3 de noviembre o antes y llega a tu condado a más tardar el 10 de noviembre. Desde el 28 de octubre, la Secretaría de Estado recomienda usar un buzón de entrega. Los buzones reciben boletas hasta las 8 p. m. del 3 de noviembre. Si tienes que enviarla por correo, pide a un empleado de la oficina postal que le ponga el matasellos a mano.
late_mail.quote: To be counted, all ballots must either be put into a drop box by 8 p.m. on Election Day or postmarked by Election Day and received within the 7-day post-election grace period.
late_mail.notes: Pass 2 Oct 30, read by curl. Nov 10: SOS 2026 Elections Calendar. Drop Box Locator: sos.oregon.gov/elections/Pages/drop-box-locator.aspx. Replaces: A mailed ballot counts if it's postmarked by November 3 and reaches your county by November 10. Since October 28, the Secretary of State recommends a drop box. If you have to mail it, ask a post office staff member to hand-stamp the postmark.
